name: Proposes Ref
description: The pull request proposes merging this branch (its head ref). Drawn only when the head lives in the base repository and the ref was observed in this batch; a fork's head is recorded on the node as `head_repository` with no edge, because the fork's refs are not in scope.

ref_name.description: The branch name as the pull request names it, without the `refs/heads/` prefix — carried so the edge reads without dereferencing the ref.
